# 1 Samuel Chapter 23 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A), Folios 164r–164v | **Source Image:** 1SA_023_page_001.jpg, 1SA_023_page_002.jpg

---

**23:1** And-they-told David, saying, "Behold, [the]-Philistines [are]-fighting against-Keilah and-they [are]-plundering the-threshing-floors."

**23:2** And-inquired David of-YHWH, saying, "Shall-I-go and-strike against-these Philistines?" And-said YHWH to-David, "Go and-strike against-[the]-Philistines and-save Keilah."

**23:3** And-said [the]-men of-David to-him, "Behold, we [are]-afraid here in-Judah, and-how-much-more if we-go to-Keilah against-[the]-battle-lines of-[the]-Philistines?"

**23:4** And-again David inquired of-YHWH, and-YHWH answered-him and-said, "Arise, go-down to-Keilah, for I [am]-giving [the]-Philistines into-your-hand."

**23:5** And-went David and-his-men to-Keilah and-fought against-[the]-Philistines, and-drove-away their-livestock and-struck them [with]-a-great striking. And-David saved the-inhabitants of-Keilah.

**23:6** And-it-was when-Abiathar son of-Ahimelech fled to-David to-Keilah, an-ephod came-down in-his-hand.

**23:7** And-it-was-told to-Saul that David had-come to-Keilah. And-said Saul, "God has-delivered-him [nikker] into-my-hand, for he-has-shut-himself-in by-coming into-a-city of-doors and-bars."

**23:8** And-Saul summoned all the-people for-war, to-go-down to-Keilah, to-besiege David and-his-men.

**23:9** And-David knew that against-him Saul [was]-devising the-evil. And-he-said to-Abiathar the-priest, "Bring-near the-ephod."

**23:10** And-said David, "YHWH, God of-Israel, Your-servant has-surely-heard that Saul seeks to-come to-Keilah, to-destroy the-city on-my-account.

**23:11** Will-the-lords of-Keilah deliver-me into-his-hand? Will-Saul come-down as-Your-servant has-heard? YHWH, God of-Israel, tell, please, Your-servant." And-said YHWH, "He-will-come-down."

**23:12** And-said David, "Will-the-lords of-Keilah deliver me and-my-men into-[the]-hand of-Saul?" And-said YHWH, "They-will-deliver."

**23:13** And-arose David and-his-men, about six-hundred men, and-went-out from-Keilah and-went-about wherever they-could-go. And-it-was-told to-Saul that David had-escaped from-Keilah, and-he-ceased to-go-out.

**23:14** And-dwelt David in-the-wilderness, in-the-strongholds, and-dwelt in-[the]-hill-country in-[the]-wilderness of-Ziph. And-sought-him Saul all the-days, but-God did-not give-him into-his-hand.

**23:15** And-saw David that Saul had-come-out to-seek his-life. And-David [was] in-[the]-wilderness of-Ziph in-Horesh.

**23:16** And-arose Jonathan son of-Saul and-went to-David to-Horesh, and-strengthened his-hand in-God.

**23:17** And-said to-him, "Do-not fear, for the-hand of-Saul my-father shall-not find-you, and-you shall-reign over Israel, and-I shall-be for-you [as]-second. And-also Saul my-father knows this."

**23:18** And-the-two-of-them cut [a covenant] before YHWH. And-David dwelt in-Horesh, and-Jonathan went to-his-house.

**23:19** And-came-up [the]-Ziphites to-Saul at-Gibeah, saying, "Is-not David hiding with-us in-the-strongholds in-Horesh, on-[the]-hill of-Hachilah, which [is]-from-[the]-south of-Jeshimon?

**23:20** And-now, according-to-all the-desire of-your-soul, O-king, come-down, come-down, and-ours [it will be] to-deliver-him into-[the]-hand of-the-king."

**23:21** And-said Saul, "Blessed [are]-you to-YHWH, for you-have-had-compassion upon-me.

**23:22** Go, please, prepare further, and-know and-see his-place where his-foot [regel] is — who saw-him there — for it-has-been-told to-me [that] he-is-very cunning.

**23:23** And-see and-know from-all the-hiding-places where he-hides, and-return to-me with-certainty [el nakohn], and-I-will-go with-you. And-it-will-be, if he-is in-the-land, then-I-will-search-him-out among-all the-thousands of-Judah."

**23:24** And-they-arose and-went to-Ziph before Saul. And-David and-his-men [were] in-[the]-wilderness of-Maon, in-the-Arabah, to-[the]-south of-Jeshimon.

**23:25** And-went Saul and-his-men to-seek. And-they-told David, and-he-went-down to-the-rock and-dwelt in-[the]-wilderness of-Maon. And-heard Saul and-pursued after-David [to the]-wilderness of-Maon.

**23:26** And-went Saul from-this-side of-the-mountain, and-David and-his-men from-that-side of-the-mountain. And-David was-hurrying to-go from-before Saul, and-Saul and-his-men [were]-surrounding David and-his-men to-capture-them.

**23:27** And-a-messenger came to Saul, saying, "Hurry and-come, for [the]-Philistines have-spread upon-the-land."

**23:28** And-returned Saul from-pursuing after-David and-went to-meet [the]-Philistines. Therefore they-called that place Sela-ha-Mahlekot [Rock of-Divisions].

**23:29** And-went-up David from-there and-dwelt in-[the]-strongholds of-En-gedi.

---
## EMET's Textual Notes

1. **23:6 — ephod**: Abiathar brings the priestly ephod to David, giving him direct access to divine oracles. This is strategically crucial — David can inquire of YHWH while Saul cannot (cf. 28:6).

2. **23:11-12 — Conditional oracle**: David asks two yes/no questions using the ephod. YHWH answers both. This is one of the clearest descriptions of binary lot-casting in the OT.

3. **23:17 — "I shall be for you as second"**: Jonathan's remarkable self-subordination — the crown prince voluntarily yields his claim to David's kingship.

4. **23:28 — Sela-ha-Mahlekot**: "Rock of Divisions/Escapes" — an etiological naming: the place where David's escape was divided from Saul's pursuit by the Philistine raid.

— EMET
